## Activity

During October 2023, Harbour Eye Clinic completed 421 captures. Session lists ran as planned, apart from routine leave. Activity was delivered in accordance with the scheduled service arrangements, with no other operational issues recorded for the reporting period.

## Image quality

There were 13 ungradable captures during the month. The ungradable rate was 3.1. This indicates that most images obtained were suitable for the grading process. The result should continue to be monitored through routine quality assurance, with attention to any recurring causes of ungradable images.

## Grading

A total of 110 results were graded as referable. The median grading lag was 1 day. This reflects the typical interval between image capture and completion of grading during October 2023. Grading activity should continue to be reviewed alongside image quality and referral outcomes to support timely follow-up and consistent service performance.
